pkgmetadata.longdescription: A minimal Plasma 6 desktop, the counterpart of gnome-base/gnome-light: the session, the compositor, System Settings, power and display management and the authentication agent -- no applications. Merge kde-plasma/plasma-meta instead for the full desktop.

use.flag: Pull in kde-plasma/bluedevil, the Bluetooth applet
Pull in kde-plasma/kwallet-pam, which unlocks the wallet at login
Pull in kde-plasma/plasma-nm, the network applet, and net-misc/networkmanager
Pull in kde-plasma/plasma-pa, the volume applet (it works with PipeWire's PulseAudio server)
